title: 15s upbeat retail pulse
prompt:
Make a 15 s upbeat ad bed sound effect for video at 30 fps.
Output: one WAV, 48 kHz / 16-bit / stereo, exactly 720000 samples.
Python + numpy/scipy only. Synthesise everything (no samples, no downloads). Fixed random seed.
Sound: bright plucks, four-on-the-floor kick, claps on 2 and 4, key E major, energetic but not harsh; hit on frame 0, tag at frame 420.
Master: −14 LUFS integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP.
Verify length, loudness, peak with ffmpeg ebur128; render spectrogram; fix until checks pass.
